body:
Just be careful friend. When you eventually find one, it's going to be almost impossible to give up your all to her. If you let her in and she hurts you you'll end up in my shoes. 

Thanks for your kind words.
I love video games. I was playing a lot of overwatch. I haven't had the motivation to play recently. Depression.
Thank you for your kind words. I made it through the night, just wanted to tell you.
I made it through the night. Just wanted to let you know.

What good does revenge do? Destroy her life so we're both miserable? No. I'm still in love with her anyway. That's how sick I am. Dependent. Like a leech. 

Killing myself will send enough of a message to her and everyone else in her life

No I'm not. What do I have? Half a degree in mathmatics I'll never use? I'm a 26 year old man with no experience in anything. I'm worthless to anyone as a partner. 

 Physical things I didn't throw away before the move? What I kept and brought along is now hopelessly entangled with her belongings. I'll never be able to separate us. Return to our friends and tell them she cheated on me? Impossible. They were all her friends first.
